record.title: Staff JWT placed in EventSource query string; same Query door authenticates catalog uploads
record.description: A lower-trust observer of API or proxy access logs, or of the HTTP request target, can recover a staff JWT. The dashboard builds EventSource on /jobs/{id}/events?access_token= plus the live token. get_current_user_sse treats Query access_token as equivalent to Authorization Bearer and mints a full User for GET /jobs/{id}/events, POST /jobs/upload, and POST /jobs/{id}/upload-files. First-party upload clients send the JWT in the Authorization header, not the query; the observed client leak is the EventSource URL. Tokens default to 43200 minutes and user_from_access_token does not bind iat to password changes. Procfile and Dockerfile.api start uvicorn without --no-access-log. Whether the running process or Railway edge actually retains the request-target query was not observed.
record.claimed_root_cause: get_current_user_sse accepts Query access_token as equivalent to Authorization Bearer, and the dashboard EventSource puts that JWT in the URL. Default uvicorn process logging records the request query.

trace.description: Browser builds /jobs/{id}/events?access_token= plus the staff JWT and opens EventSource on it.
FastAPI Query access_token is documented as the EventSource JWT and is optional beside HTTP Bearer.
Query value is OR'd with Bearer credentials and passed to user_from_access_token, minting a full User principal for SSE and for POST /jobs/upload and /jobs/{id}/upload-files.

evidence.description: EventSource URL concatenates encodeURIComponent(token) into query access_token.
token = Bearer credentials or stripped access_token query; empty raises 401.
job_events_sse Depends(get_current_user_sse) and documents query access_token.
create_job_from_upload Depends(get_current_user_sse), so query JWT also authorizes multipart catalog upload.
Production API is uvicorn app.main:app without --no-access-log.
Container CMD also launches uvicorn without disabling access logs.
change_own_password updates password_hash only; user_from_access_token still accepts prior JWTs.

blockers: OS-enforced sandbox is unavailable (empty allowlist env, no-network namespace, read-only target, trusted parent-side no-follow promotion); uvicorn access-log request-target capture was not executed.
Live Railway or proxy access-log retention for /jobs/*/events?access_token= is a host-dashboard fact and was not observed; this run must not fetch production.

validation_plan.local: In the required OS sandbox with dummy tenants, mint a JWT, then start uvicorn (not TestClient) and GET /jobs/{id}/events?access_token=<dummy-jwt> plus POST /jobs/upload?access_token=<dummy-jwt>. Confirm the query door authenticates and that the uvicorn access-log request target contains the access_token query name. Redact token values in any retained log excerpt.
validation_plan.deployment: Owner inspects existing Railway or API access-log settings and any retained /jobs/*/events?access_token= lines; do not replay live tokens or probe production.
